We will use the `xunit` framework to write the test. We will also use the `Moq` library to mock the `INotificationUpdateService` interface.

Here is the test:

<tool>submit_test(csharp)</tool>
```csharp
using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Duplicati.Library.Interface;
using System;

namespace Duplicati.Tests
{
    public class ConnectionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void SignalSettingsChanged_IncrementsLastDataUpdateId()
        {
            // Arrange
            var notificationUpdateServiceMock = new Mock<INotificationUpdateService>();
            var connection = new Connection(null, false, null, "", () => { });
            connection.SetServiceProvider(new ServiceCollection().AddSingleton(notificationUpdateServiceMock.Object).Build().ServiceProvider);

            // Act
            connection.SignalSettingsChanged();

            // Assert
            notificationUpdateServiceMock.Verify(s => s.IncrementLastDataUpdateId(), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
```
